CC BY 4.0 Sec. 3(a)(1)(B) says to note any changes: if the file is edited (trimmed, crossfaded into a new loop file, re-encoded with edits), say it was modified. Looping it unchanged at playback is not an edit. CC BY 4.0 Sec. 2(a)(5)(B) bars adding extra terms or DRM to the redistributed file; a public R2 bucket meets this. Free or paid makes no difference under CC BY.
